'''Willem''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] in the service of the [[Imperial Medical Corps]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. In [[3643 BBY]] he was stationed on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="TOR" />
